svg.title: Ishikari metro map
svg.text: One task rides from Task to MAIN. Questions only at the first stop; after that it runs on its own.
board tool writes once per stage
gets each answer as a message
tasks in a scratch copy, tests once
why is the bug still open?
writes next fix plan, never code
straight line in a scratch copy,
Build line - build, check, merge, upkeep
Bug branch - clash, stuck, merge failed
